id.ssn_last4.text: We use your SSN to verify your identity and pull your credit report. This is required by law to prevent fraud.

id.ssn_full.text: Your full SSN is needed to run your credit report and verify your identity with the IRS. We use bank-level encryption to protect it.

id.dob.text: Your date of birth helps us verify your identity and is required on the loan application.

income.base_monthly_income.text: We need your income to calculate how much home you can afford and what loan programs you qualify for.

income.employer_name.text: Your employer helps us verify your income and employment stability—both are key factors in loan approval.

assets.total_down_payment.text: Your down payment affects your loan options and monthly payment. A larger down payment often means better rates.

assets.gift_source.text: Lenders need to verify gift funds to ensure they're truly gifts, not hidden loans that would affect your qualification.

liabilities.credit_card_payment.text: We need your monthly debt payments to calculate your debt-to-income ratio—one of the most important factors in loan approval.

declarations.bankruptcy_last_7_years.text: Bankruptcy history affects which loan programs you can qualify for and how long you need to wait. Being honest helps us find the right options.

declarations.foreclosure_last_7_years.text: Like bankruptcy, foreclosure history affects loan eligibility. Different programs have different waiting periods.

property.occupancy_type.text: How you'll use the property affects your interest rate and loan options. Primary residences typically get the best rates.

property.expected_rent.text: For investment properties, rental income can help you qualify by offsetting the new mortgage payment.

consent.credit_authorization.text: We need your permission to pull your credit report. This lets us see your credit score and history to match you with the best loan options.

consent.econsent.text: E-consent lets us send you documents electronically—it's faster and more secure than paper. You can still request paper copies anytime.

va.veteran_or_surviving_spouse.text: VA loans offer special benefits like no down payment and no PMI. We ask early to make sure we don't miss this option for you.

income.self_employed_years.text: Most lenders require 2 years of self-employment history for full income documentation. Less time may still work with some programs.

address.years_at_address.text: Lenders like to see stable housing history. If you've moved recently, no worries—we'll just document your previous addresses.

generic_micro_whys.required_by_law: This information is required by federal lending regulations.
generic_micro_whys.helps_qualification: This helps us determine which loan programs you qualify for.
generic_micro_whys.protects_you: This protects both you and the lender from fraud.
generic_micro_whys.finds_best_options: This helps us find the best loan options for your situation.
generic_micro_whys.standard_question: This is a standard question on all mortgage applications.
